name: @builderforce/spend-contract
description: The SPENT vs SAVED wire contract — what a conversation or a workspace cost (Builderforce plan + own keys at list) and what memory saved it, by source, recorded vs estimated — and the one fold and cost rule that produce it from usage slices. Declared once: the api folds its ledger with it, a device folds its own run usage with it, brain-embedded / brain-ui and every client surface read it.
